answer.answer: Using date_first to assign each study to a 5-year window, 35 studies have a sampling start date in 2015-2019, versus 1 study (Law et al. 2014) starting in 2000-2004. Note some studies span multiple windows (e.g., sampling continuing past 2019 or starting before 2015), so counts could differ if based on full date ranges rather than start date.
